June 24, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Marble Harbor Investment Counsel Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.58% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marble Harbor Investment Counsel Llc bought 2,546 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 101,253 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $16.99 million, up from 98,707 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marble Harbor Investment Counsel Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $908.91B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.29% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 15.09M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 24, 2017 and is uptrending.
